name: Landbot
tagline: A Barcelona no-code chatbot builder with a genuinely thoughtful hybrid AI architecture designed specifically against hallucination — undercut by slow, 'ping-pong' customer support.
tldr: Landbot was founded in 2017 in Barcelona by Antoni Espinosa Polo, Cristobal Villar Garcia, Fran Conejos Mengo, and Fernando Guirao De Gregorio, raising $10.2M total including a €6.5M Series A in 2021 led by Swanlaab with Spain's CDTI innovation agency participating.

Pricing is unusually transparent for this category: Sandbox free (100 chats/mo), Starter €40/mo (500 chats, 100 AI chats), Pro €100/mo (2,500 chats, 300 AI chats), Business from €400/mo, with separate WhatsApp tiers (€80/mo Starter, €200/mo Pro) — and itemized overage rates published clearly (€0.05/extra chat, €0.10/extra AI chat, €25/mo per extra seat).

The AI architecture is genuinely more thoughtfully engineered than most competitors': AI Agents run on GPT with native Gemini and DeepSeek connectors, grounded in a real knowledge base (up to 200,000 characters of text, file uploads, or auto-refreshing scraped URLs), combined in an explicit 'hybrid' design meant to address both hallucination and the tendency of purely AI-driven bots to fail at capturing structured marketing data.

Integration breadth is strong — roughly 16 native integrations including Shopify, HubSpot, Stripe, and Slack, plus documented connectivity through Zapier, Make, AND n8n specifically, a combination few competitors in this category confirm all three of.

Reviews are strong on G2 (4.7/5 across 333 reviews) and solid on Capterra (4.4/5, 70 reviews), but a specific, recurring complaint describes 'ping-pong emails' with technical support — slow, multi-round back-and-forth rather than first-contact resolution — and a much smaller, harsher Trustpilot sample (2.1/5, 10 reviews) skews toward frustrated support tickets specifically.

Best for marketing and lead-generation teams wanting a genuinely well-engineered hybrid rule-plus-AI chatbot builder — not for teams that need fast, responsive support or robust built-in analytics, given the documented gaps in both.

faq.question: What makes Landbot's AI architecture different from a typical chatbot?
faq.answer: Landbot explicitly describes a 'hybrid' AI architecture that combines structured, rule-based flows with GPT-powered (plus Gemini and DeepSeek-connected) AI conversation — a deliberate design choice meant to solve two problems at once: AI hallucination, and the tendency of purely AI-driven bots to fail at capturing the structured data (like a phone number or a qualified-lead field) that marketing automation actually needs. This is a more thoughtfully engineered approach than a lot of competitors document.

faq.question: How does Landbot's knowledge base work?
faq.answer: You can add up to 200,000 characters of text directly, upload files (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, RTF), or point it at a URL for automatic web scraping — and URL-based sources can auto-refresh on a daily, weekly, or monthly schedule, so the bot's knowledge doesn't go stale the way a one-time crawl would.

faq.question: How much does Landbot actually cost?
faq.answer: Pricing is unusually clear for this category: Starter is €40/month (500 chats, 100 AI chats), Pro is €100/month (2,500 chats, 300 AI chats), and Business starts at €400/month, with a separate free Sandbox tier (100 chats/month). WhatsApp is priced separately — €80/month Starter, €200/month Pro. Overages are itemized clearly: €0.05 per extra chat, €0.10 per extra AI chat, and €25/month per additional seat beyond your tier's allowance.

faq.question: What's the most common complaint about Landbot?
faq.answer: Customer support responsiveness, specifically. Multiple Capterra reviewers describe 'ping-pong emails' with technical support — slow, multi-round back-and-forth rather than resolution on first contact — and a smaller, harsher Trustpilot sample (2.1/5 from just 10 reviews) reflects frustrated support tickets specifically rather than the broader, much more positive user base reflected in G2's 4.7/5 across 333 reviews.

faq.question: Does Landbot integrate with Shopify and HubSpot?
faq.answer: Yes, both are among Landbot's roughly 16 native integrations — though HubSpot, along with Airtable and Calendly, is specifically gated to the Pro tier (€100/month) and above rather than available on Starter.

faq.question: Is Landbot good for reporting and analytics?
faq.answer: This is a documented weak point — at least one independent review specifically titles its assessment around 'weak analytics' as Landbot's main limitation relative to its otherwise strong no-code bot-building capability. If detailed reporting is a priority, test this specifically during the trial rather than assuming it matches the platform's overall polish.

pricingBreakdown: Landbot's pricing is refreshingly precise for this category — every tier, every overage rate, and every seat add-on cost is published clearly rather than requiring a sales conversation to piece together, which is a genuine point in its favor relative to several competitors in this comparison set. The Starter tier at €40/month for 500 chats and 100 AI chats is reasonable for a small team testing the waters, and the jump to Pro at €100/month specifically unlocks HubSpot, Airtable, and Calendly — worth knowing upfront if any of those three integrations are essential to your workflow, since they're not available on Starter. WhatsApp is priced entirely separately from the core web-chat plans, and reviewers specifically flag WhatsApp Pro (€200/month) as aggressively priced relative to what it delivers — worth pricing out carefully against a WhatsApp-focused competitor if that's your primary channel rather than assuming Landbot's WhatsApp economics match its otherwise transparent web-chat pricing.

capabilities.note: Genuinely the most distinctive thing about Landbot in this comparison set: a deliberate combination of rule-based flows and multi-model AI (GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) specifically engineered to solve two real problems — hallucination risk, and the common failure of pure-AI bots to reliably capture the structured data marketing automation depends on. This is a more thoughtful design than most competitors document, and it shows real product-engineering maturity.

A genuinely well-built training system — 200,000 characters of direct text, multiple file formats, and auto-refreshing URL scraping on a configurable schedule. This level of specificity and freshness control is a real strength versus competitors that only document a vague 'upload your content' capability.

Sixteen native integrations plus confirmed Zapier, Make, and n8n connectivity is genuinely broad reach, and the n8n support specifically is distinctive — few competitors in this category confirm it. The tradeoff is that some of the most valuable integrations (HubSpot, Airtable, Calendly) are Pro-tier-gated.

A real, specific, and recurring limitation: multiple independent reviewers describe slow, multi-round 'ping-pong' email exchanges with support rather than resolution on first contact. This pattern shows up distinctly enough, and in a small but notably harsher Trustpilot sample, that it's worth testing directly during the trial rather than assuming the strong G2 average tells the whole story.

A documented, specific weakness relative to the platform's otherwise strong engineering — at least one independent review titles its entire assessment around 'weak analytics' as Landbot's primary limitation. Worth testing directly if reporting depth matters to your evaluation.

verdict: Landbot's AI engineering is genuinely more thoughtful than most competitors' in this category, and it's worth saying so directly: a deliberate hybrid architecture combining structured, rule-based flows with multi-model AI (GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) specifically designed to address both hallucination risk and the common failure of pure-AI bots to capture the structured data marketing automation actually needs is a real, documented product-engineering decision, not marketing language. That's backed by a genuinely well-built knowledge base — 200,000 characters of text, multiple file formats, auto-refreshing scraped URLs — and broad integration reach that distinctively includes n8n alongside the more common Zapier and Make. Pricing is also refreshingly transparent, with every tier and overage rate published clearly rather than requiring a sales call. Where I have to weigh things down is a real, specific, and recurring complaint pattern: independent reviewers describe slow, multi-round 'ping-pong' email exchanges with support rather than first-contact resolution, and a much harsher (if smaller-sample) Trustpilot rating reflects exactly that kind of frustration. Analytics is a separately documented weakness worth testing directly if reporting depth matters to you. My honest read: if Landbot's hybrid AI architecture and knowledge-base sophistication are what you need, and you're not relying heavily on fast support turnaround or deep built-in analytics, this is one of the more genuinely well-engineered chatbot builders in this category. If support responsiveness is a dealbreaker, test it directly during the 14-day trial before committing.
